description: This script sets up a FaunaDB database for a sample application, including importing a GraphQL schema, creating roles and keys, and generating environment configuration files.

methods.name: readline.question
methods.description: Prompts the user for the FaunaDB admin key.

methods.name: fs.createReadStream
methods.description: Creates a read stream for the schema.gql file.

methods.name: streamToPromise
methods.description: Converts a stream to a promise for asynchronous handling.

methods.name: client.query
methods.description: Executes queries against the FaunaDB database, such as creating roles and keys.

methods.name: fs.writeFile
methods.description: Writes the generated environment variables to the .env.local file.

methods.name: fs.readFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of the .env.local file for display.
